dishes.name: Figatellu
dishes.desc: A Corsican pork-liver sausage, cured or grilled fresh over embers in winter. The centrepiece of the island's charcuterie, alongside lonzu and coppa.

dishes.name: Brocciu
dishes.desc: Corsica's whey cheese, protected by AOC since 1983 and AOP since 2003. Eaten fresh or aged, and used in cannelloni, fritters and desserts.

dishes.name: Fiadone
dishes.desc: The island's emblematic dessert, a baked brocciu, egg, sugar and lemon-zest cake. Found in restaurants and bakeries all over Corsica.

dishes.name: Canistrelli
dishes.desc: Small dry Corsican biscuits made with flour, sugar and white wine. Flavours include lemon, aniseed and chestnut.

dishes.name: Civet de sanglier
dishes.desc: Wild boar stewed in a rich onion sauce, a staple of Corsican mountain cooking. Typically served with polenta or pasta.
